summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, disclosing routine transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs) and their closely associated persons. The CEO, Tadeu Marroco, and his PCA reinvested dividend income to acquire 173 ordinary shares at GBP 43.71873935 per share, totaling GBP 7,563.34. No special situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change—is involved. This filing is a standard notification of insider transactions under UK market rules, equivalent to a US Form 4 or 5 filing. No further action or analysis is warranted.
